work.title: Sites-informed canonical engagement overview
authority: Direct request to implement only the first corrected engagement overview on feature/redwood-sites-fidelity.

intent.productGoal: Present a condition-first engagement overview that helps a reviewer act on actual canonical run state.
intent.capability: The isolated /next engagement overview renders canonical gate, reconciliation, finding, source-inventory, and release-gate data through work, review, and decision lenses.
architecturalIntent: The overview remains a static /next frontend and reads only existing canonical API/run state.
The seven canonical workflow capabilities remain present and reachable; the overview is not an eighth workflow capability.
invariants: The root fallback, backend, canonical calculations, persisted runs, and existing phase screens remain unchanged.
Unreconciled differences, open findings, blocked gates, and release authority remain visible and are never inferred away.
The frontend creates no financial calculations, professional decisions, or release authority.
acceptanceEvidence: Syntax, established Workbench typecheck, and static build pass.
Existing server serves /next/index.html and a canonical persisted-run API response.
Diff review confirms root and backend files are unchanged.

decisions.decision: Add an Engagement overview entry before, but separate from, the seven workflow capabilities.
decisions.rationale: This supplies the requested first screen without redefining the canonical workflow.

decisions.decision: Derive every condition, figure, workflow label, and release position from the loaded canonical run.
decisions.rationale: This prevents fictional data and preserves API/run-state authority.

observedBehaviour: GET /next/index.html returned 200 and contains the Engagement overview entry.
Persisted run c8f21c7f-82a5-47a1-9d21-ab78af14660a returned 8 gates, 4 reconciliations, and 1 finding for overview rendering.

evidence.reference: apps/workbench: node --check public/next/workbench-next.js; pnpm run typecheck; pnpm run build; git diff --check

evidence.result: Both requests returned 200 with the expected overview entry and canonical run state.

evidence.reference: git diff -- apps/workbench/public/index.html apps/workbench/public/app.js apps/workbench/server.mjs apps/workbench/build.mjs

divergences.expected: Each material reconciliation figure can open a source-document-specific evidence thread, as in the illustrative Sites reference.
divergences.observed: The existing canonical API exposes run-bound source inventory and findings but no reconciliation-to-document thread identity; the overview opens the established run-bound evidence drawer instead.

learning.recurringPattern: A condition-first overview can improve engagement orientation when it consumes canonical state rather than summarizing invented business facts.
durableKnowledge: Sites visual patterns are adapted only at the overview layer; their illustrative figures and simulated authority were not reused.
